resources.title: Allen Brain Atlas
resources.notes: Authoritative atlas and data portal spanning cellular, anatomical and systems neuroscience.

resources.title: NIMH Data Archive
resources.notes: Human-subject protections and controlled-access restrictions must remain enforced.

resources.title: PubMed Neuroscience Literature
resources.notes: Literature discovery layer; article-level identity and license verification required.

resources.title: BRAIN Initiative
resources.notes: Primary NIH research program reference for advanced neurotechnology and circuit-level neuroscience.

resources.title: NINDS Brain Education Resources
resources.provider: National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke / NIH
resources.notes: NIH/NINDS K-12 activities and learning material cover neurons, brain anatomy, senses, reaction time and memory; mapped conservatively to introductory levels.

resources.title: NINDS Brain Basics
resources.provider: National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke / NIH
resources.notes: NINDS introductory brain-science primers provide accessible grounding in brain structure, neurons, nervous-system function and related concepts.

resources.title: NIH BRAIN Initiative Resources
resources.notes: NIH resource hub exposes BRAIN-funded tools, technologies, publications, webinars and repositories; individual assets retain their own terms and access requirements.

resources.title: NIH BRAIN Initiative Training
resources.notes: NIH describes training across undergraduate through early-career research, including quantitative/data-intensive neuroscience and neurotechnology methods.
